22 November 2023: Andrew adopted a third dog, Scout (around 20 Nov 2023; he and his girlfriend chose the name for Scout's adventurous spirit). This supersedes the 4 Nov note that he was only considering a third dog. They bought a bed, toys and puppy pads. Scout's first outing will be a small nearby park with Toby and Buddy; Scout is kept on a leash at first. Audrey advised introducing Scout slowly to Toby and Buddy. Andrew has not yet taken his dogs to a groomer but plans to soon.

4 November 2023: Andrew mentioned he had been tempted by the idea of a third dog but was unsure, as two dogs is already a lot. Audrey advised focusing on keeping Toby and Buddy happy and healthy first. He feels he has made city life with dogs work. Audrey shared city tips: daily exercise and socialization, mental stimulation (puzzles, training, hide-and-seek, fetch).

19 October 2023: Andrew recently adopted a second dog, Buddy, from a shelter (named because he hopes Buddy and Toby become buddies). Buddy is settling in; Toby needs time to get along with him. Buddy enjoys walks and checking out new hiking trails.

13 October 2023: Toby is a German Shepherd who is very active and loves cute sweaters. Andrew shared a funny story of Toby chasing a squirrel around a tree at the dog park. Andrew, his girlfriend and Toby had a board game night (around 6 Oct).

UPDATE 6 September 2023: Andrew is STILL searching for a dog-friendly place to live (challenging). This supersedes the 11 July note that the search was resolved. He has wanted to hike with Toby but it's difficult since Toby is still very young.

24 September 2023: Andrew wants a strong bond with Toby and asked Audrey for advice (patience, regular training, praise). He has also been taking care of flowers lately.

11 July 2023: Andrew adopted a puppy named Toby and lives with him in the city. Toby will meet Audrey's dogs on their planned hike.

4 August 2023: Toby is a German Shepherd. Andrew hopes to build a deep bond with him and wants him as a hiking buddy; he worries about giving Toby enough exercise and attention in the city (Audrey advised that a German Shepherd needs lots of walks and energy outlet).

On Monday 24 July 2023 Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered at a pet shelter; he found it very rewarding. He sees it as their way of giving back.

Background: Andrew loves animals; his family has a dog. He is awed by birds, especially eagles. He wanted a small dog suited to apartment life, and wants to go on road trips with his dog someday (bucket list). He agrees with positive reinforcement, no-punishment training (inspired by Audrey's workshop in June 2023).

files.reference-audrey-dogs.md:
---
name: reference-audrey-dogs
description: Audrey (the person Andrew chats with) has four city dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda, Pixie (mutts, all 3 yrs); plans pastry party; training course; agility classes; grooming course; moved to new home June 2023; hike with dogs and Andrew's puppy Toby planned; playdate and new beds Sept 2023; leash snapped 22 Sept 2023; garden; beach trip early Oct 2023; knee injury story and recycled jewelry (6 Oct 2023); dog park, snow dislike, tattoo additions (13 Oct 2023); arm injury at park (mid-Oct 2023); behaviorist visit 25 Oct 2023; joined weekly dog owners group (Nov 2023); pet salon visit ~17 Nov 2023
type: reference
---
Audrey, who Andrew chats with, has four dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie (mutts, all 3 years old: Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes, Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes per 28 Oct 2023; earlier noted as Jack Russell/Chihuahua mixes). They are city dogs who explore parks and trails often and love hikes, fetch, and doggie playdates. Audrey has a tattoo of her dogs (by 16 Aug 2023 she got another tattoo of the four dogs on her arm). She strongly opposes punishment-based training; attended a positive reinforcement workshop in June 2023 and is taking a dog training course (July 2023). She moved in June 2023 to a new house with a big backyard with agility equipment. She walks them about an hour daily. She offered to help Andrew find pet-friendly housing.

Audrey loves cooking: Chicken Pot Pie (family recipe) and garlic-lemon-herb Roasted Chicken; she promised to send Andrew both recipes. A "pastry party" with her dogs was floated in April 2023.

8 July 2023: she and Andrew agreed to hike together with her dogs in August 2023 (off-leash space, dog safety a priority). On 11 July 2023 she confirmed again, and showed personalized tags she made herself for each dog. Andrew's new puppy Toby will join and meet her dogs.

27 July 2023: she described the dogs' personalities (oldest is relaxed like a wise sage, second loves games, third is naughty but cuddly, youngest is adventurous). Her childhood dog was Max, an energetic fetch lover; they took long neighborhood walks. She has never visited an animal shelter but would like to volunteer someday.

4 August 2023: she started agility classes with her dogs at a dog park and takes them to the park twice a week to practice. She recently did a two-hour trail hike with them.

16 August 2023: she would like more dogs but says four is enough for now. She took all four to the vet together (chaotic; next time one by one). Favorite spots: Pepper the couch, Pixie her bed, Precious her chair, Panda his rug. They always cuddle and nap together.

19 August 2023: she took a dog grooming course and now grooms her dogs herself. Tips: groom slowly and gently, mind sensitive areas like ears and paws, stay patient and positive. She offered Andrew more advice if he tries grooming Toby.

6 September 2023: she organized a doggy playdate with the neighbors' dogs, and bought the dogs new cozy beds the week before as the weather cools. She does at least one self-care activity daily.

24 September 2023: on Friday 22 Sept at the park Precious pulled so hard the leash broke; Audrey chased and caught her, calmed her with hugs and a slow walk. She trains obedience and tricks (sit, stay, shake, roll over) and walks them multiple times a day. She keeps a small garden with a veggie patch and Peruvian Lilies. Her advice on bonding: patience, regular training, praise successes.

4 October 2023: she took the dogs to the beach the previous weekend (around 30 Sep-1 Oct); they loved swimming and playing in the ocean.

6 October 2023: she once had a knee injury that kept her from walking the dogs (tough for her); shared a photo after she resumed walking. She makes jewelry from recycled items (bottle caps, buttons, broken jewelry), started as a hobby, now sells it, and donates a portion of profits to an animal shelter. She can no longer volunteer at shelters (Andrew noted this), so donating is how she helps.

13 October 2023: she baked goodies for neighbors to thank them for their pup-friendly homes. Her dogs love the dog park (fetch, Frisbee, socializing) but hate snow (confused by it last winter). She added more drawings to her dog tattoo; says enough for now, maybe another if she gets a fifth dog. Life has been crazy so she hasn't walked the dogs much lately; wants to hike with them soon as therapy.

24 October 2023: about the week of 16-20 Oct she had an accident while playing with the dogs at the park and is managing with one arm; feeling better each day. She loves sushi.

28 October 2023: the dogs hadn't been acting normally, so she saw an animal behaviorist on Wed 25 Oct 2023. She got routine changes and tips, is using positive reinforcement, and sees some progress (still a work in progress).

4 November 2023: she recently joined a dog owners group and meets other dog owners weekly for tips and playtime for the dogs. Last weekend the dogs had fun at a park. Her indoor/city routine for the dogs: toys and games, puzzles, training, hide-and-seek, fetch at the park.

22 November 2023: last Friday (17 Nov 2023) she took the dogs to a pet salon; they were excited and well behaved there, and looked great groomed. She worries about them in new places, but they did well. The dogs are doing great, exploring and meeting new people.
